zh.title: 历史批准、专属前驱与再次询问：批准究竟管哪一次？
zh.summary: 对照两组独立作者披露的审批契约与同日内部隔离探针，区分历史存在、前驱约束和逐次检查，保留重试与持久消费的未知边界。

en.title: A Past Approval, a Dedicated Predecessor, or a Fresh Question?
en.summary: Two independently authored approval contracts and a same-date internal isolated probe distinguish historical presence, predecessor constraints and per-call inspection, while leaving retry and durable consumption guarantees unresolved.
